# Datamerging

This script combines 2026 data for Effektovervåking dragehode with the data used for analyses in 2025. This data contains registrations for 2023, 2024 and 2025. This script will produce a combined dataset that allows for analyses of data from all three years.

## Required packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)
```

## Importing data

```{r}

# File paths
old_path <- here::here("data", "Dragehode_2025_cleaned.xlsx")
new_path <- here::here("data", "S123_2026", "Effekt_dragehode_2026_processed", "Exports", "Effekt_dragehode_2026_data_analyses.xlsx")
output_path <- here::here("data", "Dragehode_2023_2026_analyses.xlsx")

# Import as text to ensure compatible column types.
# Measurement columns are converted to numeric below.
old <- read_excel(
  old_path,
  sheet = 1,
  col_types = "text")

plots_2026 <- read_excel(
  new_path,
  sheet = "plots",
  col_types = "text")

species_2026 <- read_excel(
  new_path,
  sheet = "plot_species_long",
  col_types = "text")


```

## Merging 2026 data to 2023-2025 dataframe

```{r}

# Standardise plot IDs
old <- old %>%
  mutate(
    plot_id_full = str_replace_all(plot_id_full, "_", "-")
  )

plots_2026 <- plots_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    main_plot_id = str_replace_all(main_plot_id, "_", "-")
  )

species_2026 <- species_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    main_plot_id = str_replace_all(main_plot_id, "_", "-")
  )

# Provisional correction of H. perforatum in 2024.
# The 0.1% record is probably Hypericum maculatum.
old <- old %>%
  mutate(
    species = if_else(
      year == "2024" &
        plot_id_full == "H-B-S-D-1" &
        species == "Hypericum_perforatum" &
        as.numeric(species_cover) == 0.1,
      "Hypericum_maculatum",
      species
    )
  )

# Remove completely identical rows, including the exact duplicate in 2025
old <- old %>%
  distinct()

# Columns identifying one plot visit
join_key <- c(
  "main_location_id",
  "main_plot_id",
  "event_time"
)

# Check that the plot sheet has one row per plot visit
duplicate_plots <- plots_2026 %>%
  count(across(all_of(join_key))) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(duplicate_plots) > 0) {
  print(duplicate_plots)
  stop("The 2026 plot sheet contains duplicate plot visits.")
}

# Check that every species record has a matching plot visit
unmatched_species <- species_2026 %>%
  anti_join(plots_2026, by = join_key)

if (nrow(unmatched_species) > 0) {
  print(unmatched_species)
  stop("Some 2026 species records have no matching plot visit.")
}

# Join species records to plot measurements.
# Select only species-level columns here to avoid duplicate cover columns.
new <- species_2026 %>%
  select(
    all_of(join_key),
    plot_species,
    plot_cover_species,
    plot_subplot_count
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    plots_2026,
    by = join_key
  )

# Reformat 2026 to match the older analysis table
new <- new %>%
  transmute(
    parenteventid = parentglobalid,

    plot_id_full = main_plot_id,

    # Separate the polygon ID and final plot number
    polygon_id = str_remove(main_plot_id, "-[0-9]+$"),
    plot_id = str_extract(main_plot_id, "[0-9]+$"),

    # Actual management is not recorded in the supplied 2026 workbook
    treatment_realised = NA_character_,

    cover_field_layer = plot_cover_fieldlayer,

    count_dragehode_seedlings = plot_freq_focalspecies1,
    count_dragehode_vegetative = plot_freq_focalspecies2,
    count_dragehode_fertile = plot_freq_focalspecies3,

    cover_bottom_layer = plot_cover_bottomlayer,
    cover_litter = plot_cover_litter,
    cover_rock = plot_cover_bedrock,
    cover_bare_soil = plot_cover_baresoil,
    cover_woody_plants_field_layer = plot_cover_lowwoody,
    cover_shrub_layer = plot_cover_shrubs,
    cover_tree_layer = plot_cover_trees,

    species = plot_species,

    # Convert proportions in the 2026 export back to percentage cover
    species_cover = as.numeric(plot_cover_species) * 100,

    year = substr(event_time, 1, 4),
    month = substr(event_time, 5, 6),
    day = substr(event_time, 7, 8),

    vegheight1 = plot_height_vegetation1,
    vegheight2 = plot_height_vegetation2,
    vegheight3 = plot_height_vegetation3,
    vegheight4 = plot_height_vegetation4,

    # Assigned mowing treatment, derived from the plot ID
    treatment = case_when(
      str_detect(main_plot_id, "^H-[^-]+-IS-") ~ "ingen",
      str_detect(main_plot_id, "^H-[^-]+-S-") ~ "slått",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    plot_subplot_count = plot_subplot_count
  )

# Measurement columns that should be numeric
numeric_cols <- c(
  "cover_field_layer",
  "count_dragehode_seedlings",
  "count_dragehode_vegetative",
  "count_dragehode_fertile",
  "cover_bottom_layer",
  "cover_litter",
  "cover_rock",
  "cover_bare_soil",
  "cover_woody_plants_field_layer",
  "cover_shrub_layer",
  "cover_tree_layer",
  "species_cover",
  paste0("vegheight", 1:4)
)

# Convert numeric columns, stopping if unexpected text is encountered
numeric_checked <- function(x) {
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

  invalid <- !is.na(x) & str_trim(as.character(x)) != "" & is.na(out)

  if (any(invalid)) {
    stop(
      "Unexpected text in a numeric column: ",
      paste(unique(x[invalid]), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  out
}

old <- old %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(numeric_cols), numeric_checked),
    plot_subplot_count = NA_real_
  )

new <- new %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(c(numeric_cols, "plot_subplot_count")),
      numeric_checked
    )
  )

# Determine observed dragehode presence in 2026 from counts or cover.
# This is separate from assigned D/ID treatment.
dragehode_counts <- c(
  "count_dragehode_seedlings",
  "count_dragehode_vegetative",
  "count_dragehode_fertile"
)

new <- new %>%
  mutate(
    presence_dragehode = case_when(
      if_any(all_of(dragehode_counts), ~ .x > 0) |
        (species == "Dracocephalum_ruyschiana" &
           species_cover > 0) ~ "present",

      if_all(all_of(dragehode_counts), ~ !is.na(.x)) ~ "fravær",

      species == "Dracocephalum_ruyschiana" &
        !is.na(species_cover) ~ "fravær",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Match the older column order, followed by the new subplot-count column
new <- new %>%
  select(all_of(names(old)))

# Append 2026 observations to the older table
dat <- bind_rows(old, new) %>%
  arrange(
    year,
    month,
    day,
    plot_id_full,
    species
  )

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    parenteventid = if_else(
      is.na(parenteventid),
      NA_character_,
      paste0(
        "{",
        str_remove_all(parenteventid, "[{}]"),
        "}"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("polygon_id", "plot_id")))

# Validate the combined table
stopifnot(
  nrow(dat) == nrow(old) + nrow(new),
  !anyNA(new$treatment),
  all(is.na(dat$species_cover) |
        between(dat$species_cover, 0, 100)),
  all(is.na(dat$plot_subplot_count[dat$year != "2026"]))
)

# Number of plot visits per year
dat %>%
  distinct(year, month, day, plot_id_full) %>%
  count(year) %>%
  print()
```

## Export data

```{r}

# Export one table in one sheet
dir.create(
  dirname(output_path),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE)

write.xlsx(
  list(data = dat),
  file = output_path,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  asTable = FALSE,
  keepNA = FALSE,
  firstRow = TRUE)
```
